name: Flip-Out propensity - Gradient boosting (HistGradientBoosting), base features
target: Flip-Out: in each of the next 2 months, non-OXXO share of spend rises >= 10 pp vs. the last 6 months and the user makes >= 2 non-OXXO purchases
train: Snapshot T1 = 31-Dec-2025 (obs. Jul-Dec 2025, outcome Jan-Feb 2026), 13,665 eligible users, 5-fold CV
test: Snapshot T2 = 31-May-2026, out-of-time (obs. Dec 2025-May 2026, outcome Jun-Jul 2026), 12,662 eligible users
changes: Algorithm: logistic regression (v1.0) -> gradient boosting, which captures non-linear effects of the OXXO share level and purchase frequency. CV PR-AUC 0.513 -> 0.547.
Out-of-time test (T2): PR-AUC 0.557 -> 0.558; capture in the top 10% 18.7% -> 18.8%.
Stage 1 features (PCA scores + persona) were tested as inputs and dropped: CV PR-AUC gain of only 0.002, smaller than the variation between folds. Persona is kept for targeting and reporting.
Class weights for the imbalance were tested; no gain, so they are not used.
The model is now linked to value: every user in the target list carries a CLTV estimate (0.5% OXXO / 1.0% outside commission assumption).
